definition: to drink all of it quickly
description: Inside a roadside diner with ceiling fans and a checkered floor, a young woman in a black leather jacket and boots stands on a red bar stool and tips back a huge glass of pink milkshake, gulping it down. Then she lowers the glass, shouts with joy and raises her fist high. A crowd of bearded bikers in leather vests cheers and points at her, a waitress in a pink uniform holding a metal jug stares and then smiles, and burgers sit on the counter.
